`toCsv` in `src/exports/csvExport.ts` now has a `created_at` column as the last column. I haven't run it or any tests, and I didn't check that `ExportRow` in `./types` has a `createdAt` field.

Each value is formatted with `toUtcIso(r.createdAt)` from `src/time.ts`, so it comes out as second-precision UTC, for example `2026-10-16T12:00:00Z`. That follows the repo rule against calling `toISOString()` directly.

Since this changes the export format, the repo notes say to tag @jordan on the PR.

I also noticed that `exportCsv` has two existing problems. I left both alone because they're outside this change:
- It uses `console.log`, where the repo rule is to use `logger`.
- It doesn't call `assertSingleCustomer(rows)` before upload.

I can fix those as well if you'd like.
